text: The universe is vast and mysterious, comprising billions of stars, planets, and galaxies that move through space in an intricate dance. A tool known as the telescope has played a pivotal role in the field of astronomy. Telescopes consist of lenses and mirrors that gather light from the sky and focus it into a single point of light. With this technology, astronomers can observe distant galaxies, planets, and nebulae, as well as study the underlying structure of the universe. However, while telescopes have made astronomical observations possible, they have also raised important questions about the nature of the universe and the laws of physics.
